Package com.vectorpeaks.backend.controller

Class UserController

java.lang.Object
com.vectorpeaks.backend.controller.UserController
@RestController @RequestMapping("/api/users") @CrossOrigin(origins="*") public class UserController extends Object
Manages user-related operations. Provides endpoints to retrieve and add users, update profile data, anonymize accounts (GDPR deletion), and register new users.
Version:
1.3
Author:
EduLink Team

      @GetMapping @PreAuthorize("hasRole(\'ADMIN\')") public List<User> getAllUsers()

      list of all users in the system

    • addUser

      @PostMapping @PreAuthorize("hasRole(\'ADMIN\')") public User addUser(@RequestBody User user)
      Adds a new user to the database.

      Returns:
      the saved user (including generated ID)

    • getUserById

      @GetMapping("/{id}") @PreAuthorize("isAuthenticated()") public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<User> getUserById(@PathVariable Integer id)
      Retrieves a user by their ID.
      Parameters:
      id - the user ID
      Returns:
      the user (without sensitive data like password)

    • updateUser

      @PutMapping("/{id}") @PreAuthorize("#id == authentication.principal or hasRole(\'ADMIN\')") public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<?> updateUser(@PathVariable Integer id, @RequestBody User updatedUser)
      Updates a user's profile (address and phone number). Validation: phone number must be 9 digits, address at least 2 characters.
      Parameters:
      id - the user ID
      updatedUser - object containing new address and phone number
      Returns:
      updated user or error message if validation fails or user not found

    • deleteUser

      @DeleteMapping("/{id}") @PreAuthorize("#id == authentication.principal or hasRole(\'ADMIN\')") public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<?> deleteUser(@PathVariable Integer id)
      Anonymizes a user account (GDPR‑style deletion). All personal data are overwritten, the account becomes unusable.
      Parameters:
      id - the user ID
      Returns:
      ResponseEntity with success or error message

    • updateUserStatus

      @PutMapping("/{id}/status") @PreAuthorize("hasRole(\'ADMIN\')") public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<?> updateUserStatus(@PathVariable Integer id, @RequestBody Map<String,Integer> body)
      Updates a user's account status (e.g., block/unblock).
      Parameters:
      id - the user ID
      body - map containing "accountStatusId" key
      Returns:
      updated user or error if user not found

    • register

      @PostMapping("/register") @PreAuthorize("permitAll()") public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<?> register(@RequestBody RegisterRequest request)
      Registers a new user account with validation and password hashing. All fields are required, email must be valid and unique, role must be 2 or 3.
      Parameters:
      request - the registration data
      Returns:
      ResponseEntity with success or error message

    • registerFcmToken

      @PostMapping("/{userId}/fcm-token") @PreAuthorize("#userId == authentication.principal or hasRole(\'ADMIN\')") public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<?> registerFcmToken(@PathVariable Integer userId, @RequestBody Map<String,String> body)
      Registers a device FCM token for the specified user. Stores in user_fcm_tokens table — supports multiple devices per user. Called by the mobile app after login to enable push notifications.
      Parameters:
      userId - the ID of the user
      body - request body containing the fcmToken field
      Returns:
      200 OK if registered, 404 if user not found
